articles.description:
Bitcoin is trading slightly above $95,000 as the new week kicks off with rising expectations. After months of volatility and uncertainty, BTC has started to show signs of strength, breaking above the critical $90K mark — a major pivot zone for market sentiment. Bulls are now in short-term control, fueling hopes for a larger recovery rally. However, caution remains high as global trade tensions between the US and China continue to create an unstable financial backdrop.
 
 
One of the most notable developments is Bitcoin’s changing behavior relative to US equities. For the first time in months, BTC appears to be decoupling from traditional markets, a shift analysts believe could trigger an aggressive surge if current levels hold.
